before.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass allocates section information from it.
before.reason: The harness calls read_begin before the pass; before the change, read_begin initializes notes.

after.requirement: Initialize notes before the assembly pass allocates section information from it.
after.reason: Initialization is now in main, which the harness bypasses; read_begin initializes only cond_obstack.

claims.reason: The old harness satisfies initialization through read_begin before the change. After the move to main, its direct call path leaves that requirement unsatisfied.

location.dependency_reason: Before the g0006 main change, main calls read_begin before the assembly pass; read_begin initializes notes for that pass.
